arStrings.szText: Primary Skill: Unleash a rapid flurry of blows, increasing your attack speed with each hit.
While {c_important}Frenzy{/c} is granting {c_number}[{SF_1} * 3 * 100|%+|]{/c} bonus Attack Speed, the Fury costs of your {c_important}Core{/c} Skills are reduced by {c_number}[{SF_20}*100}|%|]{/c}.
{c_important}Frenzy{/c} stacks up an additional {c_number}{SF_33}{/c} times and you gain {c_important}{u}Berserking{/u}{/c} for {c_number}{SF_29}{/c} seconds while at maximum stacks.

{c_important}Frenzy{/c} becomes a ranged attack that pierces enemies, dealing {c_number}{payload:TOOLTIP_DAMAGE_UPGRADEB}{/c} damage. 

{c_important}Frenzy{/c} has a {c_number}[{SF_41}*100|%|]{/c} chance while at maximum {c_important}Frenzy{/c} stacks to ricochet {c_important}{u}Iron Shrapnel{/u}{/c}, dealing {c_number}{payload:UPGRADE_B_SHRAPNEL_TOOLTIP}{/c} damage and inflicting {c_number}{dot:UPGRADE_B_BLEED_DOT}{/c} Bleeding damage over {c_number}{buffduration:UPGRADE_B_BLEED_DOT}{/c} seconds.

{c_important}Frenzy{/c} now deals Fire damage.

{c_label}Lucky Hit:{/c} {c_important}Frenzy{/c} has up to a {c_number}[{SF_30}*100|%|]{/c} chance when attacking at maximum {c_important}Frenzy{/c} stacks to cause a fiery explosion, dealing {c_number}{dot:UPGRADEC_FIRE_DOT}{/c} Burning damage over {c_number}{buffduration:UPGRADEC_FIRE_DOT}{/c} seconds.
Each stack of {c_important}Frenzy{/c} gained also grants a stack of {c_important}{u}Ferocity{/u}{/c}.
While at maximum {c_important}Frenzy{/c} stacks, you are {c_important}{u}Unhindered{/u}{/c}.
